summary: Lane County lookout above Oakridge: a 1918 cabin, a 1927 D-6 cupola, a 1940 L-4 cab removed in 1968 or 1970. The rock is reached by Forest Service trail #3607.

facts.design: D-6 cupola cabin (1927), then an L-4 cab (1940)
facts.status_note: The L-4 cab came down in 1968 or 1970, depending on the source; no source describes what remains on the rock.

access.note: Reached on Willamette National Forest trail #3607; open to hikers, horses and mountain bikes; motorcycles prohibited.

visit.trail_note: Trail #3607 is 4.0 miles; the upper 0.3 miles reach the top of Larison Rock; closed to mountain bikes November through March.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page gives c.1925 for the D-6 cupola, but its own October 1925 item announces material that would soon be ordered, and 1927 items report the house readied for shipment and going up. The register's 1927 date matches the construction reports.

notes_for_editor: Removal year disagrees: 1968 (Forest Lookouts) vs 1970 (register; firelookout.com 'destroyed'). Distance from Oakridge disagrees: five miles (1925 newspaper) vs three (firelookout.com). The 1918 first cabin appears only in the register and firelookout.com; the Forest Lookouts page does not confirm it. The Forest Lookouts c.1920 alidade item is not tied explicitly to Larison Rock, so it is not used. No source describes remains on the rock today; the Forest Service trail page describes the rock only as a hiking destination. Record design D-6 matches the 1927 cabin, not the 1940 L-4.
